t: Core Principles of AI-Predicted Extreme Weather Adaptation

provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.

Principle 2: do no additional harm: interventions must clear an ecological safety review. Principle 3: permanence matters: temporary removal is not the same as durable removal. Principle 4: local consent is required: affected communities decide, not distant planners. The piece records show where each principle is enforced in hardware and software.

t: Key Vocabulary of AI-Predicted Extreme Weather Adaptation
title: Key Vocabulary of AI-Predicted Extreme Weather Adaptation
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Six terms unlock the whole database. carbon removal: taking carbon dioxide out of the air or ocean and storing it durably. additionality: proof the benefit would not have happened without the intervention. permanence: how long removed carbon stays out of the atmosphere. MRV: monitoring, reporting, and verification of claimed outcomes. ecosystem services: the benefits nature provides: clean water, pollination, flood control. tipping point: a threshold beyond which change becomes self-reinforcing.
